method: git grep -ciE over tracked files, binaries excluded

patternCounts.category: repo dir name / package name in prose

categories.name: bundleIdentifier
categories.compatibility: NSUserDefaults and most system prefs are keyed by CFBundleIdentifier — changing this orphans existing user data unless migrated (see user-data-rename-migration.json)
categories.test: check-version-consistency.sh; new UserDataMigration tests (planned, not yet written)
categories.rollback: revert Info.plist/PublicIdentity fields; old bundle ID's data untouched if migration only copies, never deletes source

categories.name: executableAndPackageName
categories.compatibility: process name only, no persisted state keyed on this string directly
categories.test: swift build success, test-distribution.sh arm64/launch checks

categories.name: swiftTestTargetFolder
categories.compatibility: SwiftPM convention <Target>Tests — folder rename must stay in sync with the target rename or the test target breaks
categories.rollback: revert folder rename + Package.swift target reference together, atomically

categories.name: localUserData
categories.compatibility: real user data on disk (SQLite store, Quarantine files, FSEvents fingerprint cache) -- see user-data-rename-migration.json for the full plan
categories.rollback: old directory never deleted by the migration -- copy-based, not move-based

categories.name: menuBarAndUI
categories.oldValue: MacCare Local (display string, data-driven from CFBundleName)
categories.compatibility: UI text derives from Info.plist, not hardcoded in Sources/ menu bar view

categories.name: urlSchemesLoginItemNotifications
categories.compatibility: none found -- no CFBundleURLSchemes, no SMAppService/login-item code, no UNNotificationCategory identifiers exist in Sources/ today

categories.name: scripts
categories.oldValue: MacCare Local / MacCareLocal (comments, output strings, DMG volume name/window title)

categories.name: releaseArtifacts
categories.compatibility: generated artifacts, not persisted user data
categories.rollback: rebuild artifacts under the old name

categories.name: website
categories.oldValue: MacCare Local (30 generated files + generator source)
categories.compatibility: single source of truth (generate.py) regenerates all 30 output files -- not 30 manual edits
categories.test: regenerate + check-markdown-links.py-equivalent for HTML, manual review
categories.rollback: regenerate from the old generate.py content (git revert)

categories.name: documentation
categories.compatibility: prose only, highest file-count category, needs manual review pass not blind find-replace (context-sensitive: some historical/HISTORICAL-marked sections should NOT be rewritten, they are point-in-time records)

categories.name: legalAndTrademark
categories.compatibility: governance documents -- deliberate manual review required, not a blind find-replace

categories.name: ciWorkflows
categories.oldValue: MacCare Local (titles/labels in workflow + issue-template YAML)
categories.compatibility: text-only, never pushed/run remotely yet (no remote configured)

categories.name: fixturesAndComments
categories.oldValue: maccare-*-UUID() temp-dir naming patterns in test fixtures
categories.compatibility: arbitrary collision-avoidant temp names, zero functional coupling to the brand
categories.test: existing test suite unaffected either way
